# Welcome to Cedar Demo

This fictional handbook helps a new teammate find the right starting point.

## First week

- Read the team purpose and working agreements.
- Ask your onboarding buddy where to find current procedures.
- Keep customer information out of practice pages.

## Working agreements

We write **clear decisions**, keep *context* with the work and ask before sharing externally.

| Topic | Responsible team | Review cadence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Onboarding | People operations | Monthly |
| Knowledge quality | Documentation team | Quarterly |

## When something is unclear

Leave a comment with the question and the outcome you need. Assign a page owner in Review when the page is ready for regular maintenance.
